item.title: Greene County jury convicts former Brookline fire chief of rape, sodomy
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — A Greene County jury has found a former Brookline fire chief guilty of statutory sodomy and rape following a four-day retrial stemming from the sexual abuse of a teenage cadet.
